summary: Dental Lounge offers a free consultation, a before and after slider with 10 pairs and a payment plans page. Dead links and mismatched details weaken a practice with several clinics.

findings.problem: The Bowral navigation and footer links and the Treatments parent menu point to #. The Sydney CBD footer phone links to the Double Bay number.
findings.cost: A patient who clicks Bowral or calls the CBD number from the footer reaches the wrong place, and you lose the booking.
findings.fix: Working links and the correct phone number for each clinic.

findings.problem: The Porcelain Veneers heading has no content, Composite Veneers appears twice, and About Dental Implants repeats.
findings.cost: Empty and repeated sections on your highest value treatment page send patients to a competitor who explains it clearly.
findings.fix: One clear page per treatment with a from price.

findings.problem: Several bios use different names from their titles (Dr Kalos and Jemima, Dr Gavan and Iain), and one mentions a Balmain practice that is not a current clinic. Typos include steralisation and Dental Lounge,working.
findings.cost: Inconsistent doctor names and typos in a clinical site make patients doubt who will treat them.
findings.fix: Verified doctor profiles and a proofread build.

findings.problem: No patient reviews or star ratings appear, the only quote is from a dentist, and the before and after slider has no captions or consent notes. Every button goes to a separate booking page.
findings.cost: Patients choose cosmetic clinics on peer proof, and an extra click to book costs enquiries.
findings.fix: Captioned results, Google reviews and a short booking form on each page.

redesign: A proof first homepage with captioned results and Google reviews beside every booking button.
A booking form on every page and correct details for each clinic.
